name: aisstream.io
feeds: Live ship positions, identity, speed, course, draught, destination
note: Server-side only. Browsers may not connect directly. 3 connections per account. No uptime guarantee.

name: SEC EDGAR
feeds: Every US-listed company with its state, filings, insider trades, fund holdings
note: No key. Requires a contact email in the request header. 10 requests a second. A nightly bulk file has every company at once.

name: USAspending.gov
feeds: Federal contract awards by company, agency, state and county

name: USDA NASS Quick Stats
feeds: Cattle, hogs, poultry, dairy and crops by state

name: FRED (St. Louis Fed)
feeds: Rates, inflation, jobs and thousands of US and state series

name: US Energy Information Administration
feeds: Oil and gas inventories, refinery runs, output and prices by state

name: Bureau of Economic Analysis
feeds: GDP and personal income by state and industry

name: Bureau of Labor Statistics
feeds: Jobs, unemployment and wages by state and metro
note: Free registration key: 500 queries a day. The key must be renewed once a year.

name: US Census Bureau
feeds: Population, income, building permits, and trade by port and product

name: CFTC Commitments of Traders
feeds: Who is long and short each US futures contract

name: ICE Futures Europe reports
feeds: Brent positioning by trader group
note: Weekly files, no API. Parsed from the published reports.

name: Port authority releases
feeds: Monthly container counts at Los Angeles, Long Beach, New York, Savannah, Houston and others
note: No API. Each port publishes its own page or file.

name: Railroad weekly traffic reports
feeds: Rail carloads and intermodal units
note: No API. Parsed from the weekly release.

name: World Bank Indicators
feeds: GDP, inflation, trade and population for every country

name: IMF Data
feeds: Country forecasts, reserves, balance of payments

name: UN Comtrade
feeds: Imports and exports by product between any two countries
note: Free tier has daily limits.

name: Eurostat
feeds: European economy, trade and energy statistics

name: Wikidata
feeds: Companies listed on exchanges outside the US, with country and exchange
note: Free but patchy. Good enough to start, not complete.

name: OpenFIGI
feeds: Matches a ticker on any exchange to one company identity

name: GLEIF legal entity records
feeds: Legal name, country and parent company for firms worldwide

name: USGS Earthquakes
feeds: Earthquakes near mines, plants and ports

name: National Weather Service
feeds: Storms, freezes and floods over US crops, ports and plants
note: No key. Requires a contact in the request header.

name: NASA FIRMS
feeds: Satellite wildfire detections worldwide

name: GDELT
feeds: World news events pinned to places: strikes, protests, conflicts, policy moves

name: Treasury sanctions lists
feeds: Sanctioned people, companies and ships

name: openFDA
feeds: Drug and device approvals and recalls by company
note: Works without a key at lower limits.

name: USPTO PatentsView
feeds: Patents filed and granted by company
note: Key required on every request. New key requests may be paused at the moment, so confirm before counting on it.

name: OpenSky Network
feeds: Live aircraft positions, for cargo flights
note: Free access is licensed for research and internal testing only. Showing it in a paid product needs a commercial license from OpenSky.

name: USDA Foreign Agricultural Service
feeds: Weekly export sales and world crop and meat supply

name: UK Contracts Finder
feeds: UK government contract awards

name: EU Tenders Electronic Daily
feeds: European Union and member state contract awards
note: Searching published notices needs no key or account.

name: SAM.gov
feeds: Federal contract opportunities before they are awarded
note: Free personal key, but only 10 requests a day without a role in SAM. The nightly public extract needs no key and suits a daily pull better.

name: Delayed market prices
feeds: Stock and futures prices, delayed or end of day
note: Vendor to choose. Low cost for delayed data. Real-time quotes need exchange licenses and cost far more.

name: Ship registry details
feeds: Each ship's design draught, deadweight and owner
note: This is what tells a loaded tanker from an empty one. Usually paid. Vendor to choose.

name: Exchange listings outside the US
feeds: Complete company lists for London, Tokyo, Hong Kong and other exchanges
note: Wikidata and OpenFIGI cover part of this for free. A paid vendor makes it complete.

name: Ocean bills of lading
feeds: Which company imported what, from which supplier, on which ship
note: Public record. Route to choose: the dataset on AWS Marketplace under the existing AWS account, or a records request to US Customs.

name: Satellite ship tracking
feeds: Ship positions in mid-ocean, beyond the reach of shore stations
note: Paid. Only needed if the gaps in the free feed matter.

name: Paid plan prices and checkout links
feeds: The prices shown on the site and where the upgrade buttons send people
note: Prices to set. Paste the two payment links and the upgrade buttons switch on. Until then the site says pricing is being set.

name: Stripe
feeds: Takes payment and tells the server when someone subscribes or cancels
note: The account is free. Stripe keeps a fee from each payment. Until this is built, a paid plan is switched on by hand with the admin command.

name: Amazon SES
feeds: Password reset emails and copies of contact form messages
note: Uses the mail setup the brand site already has in us-east-2. Until this is built, contact messages are saved on the server and password resets are done by hand.

name: Admin token
feeds: Lets the owner switch an account between free and paid from the server
note: Not an outside service. A long random value you make up and keep private.
